name: Bare Core
notes: Somewhere for a run to start from: the one module that makes a hull a ship, and nothing else. It cannot move, cannot shoot and cannot turn, so everything it ever has is something selection paid for — which is the point, since a seed with an engine on it has already been told which way a ship is meant to go. Two metres square because that is four berths a side on the mutation grid: small enough to be nothing, big enough that there is somewhere to put the first thing it grows.
